messages:
Raj (PM): quick sync — starting a short thread on long-term roadmap for routing + multi-tenant isolation. need to capture tradeoffs, customer asks, and a minimal launch checklist for a Q4 pilot.
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): +1. main question: do we default to latency-first routing or cost-aware routing for new tenants? customers are asking for predictable p95.
Marie (Eng-Architecture): latency-first for PLG/onboarding to avoid surprise UX issues, but we should offer a cost-tiered policy as an opt-in. propose 3 default policies: latency, cost, residency.
Evan (Eng-ML): also need model-aware fallback rules — if a model variant is unavailable, fallback should prefer compatible quantized variant rather than remote region to keep p50 down.
Lisa (Solutions): tagging a couple customer asks: finance wants cost caps per route; regulated customer asks for strict region pinning + audit log for rollouts.
Raj (PM): agreed. goal: define launch criteria + a lightweight policy DSL we can ship in Q4 pilot. Marie, can you sketch minimal DSL options?
Marie (Eng-Architecture): sketching now — keeping it tiny. example: 
```
policy: 
  - match: tenant_tier == gold -> route: latency_prefer
  - match: data_residency == eu -> route: region_pin(eu-west-1)
  - fallback: quantized_variant_then_remote
```
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): good. need to add SLO guardrails: per-route p95 < 250ms for latency_prefer, or queue with backpressure if exceeded. who owns the SLO verification?
Evan (Eng-ML): runtime team can emit the p95 per model+route metric. we can add an automated fallback to a lower-cost route if p95 breaches for >2m and traffic is non-critical. critical routes (gold/regulatory) should not auto-evacuate.
Lisa (Solutions): customer-facing launch criteria we should communicate: 1) documented behavior for policy precedence, 2) audit logs for routing decisions, 3) region pinning guarantee for residency-tier, 4) cost cap and alerts.
Raj (PM): prioritize minimal and measurable launch checklist. draft from this thread: 
- Policy DSL v0 (match + route + fallback) implemented
- SLO instrumentation + per-route dashboards
- Rollout plan: canary with 5% of eligible tenants -> 25% -> 100%
- Migration playbook for tenants that require region pinning
- Customer-facing docs + examples
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): technical constraints to call out: cross-region KV cache invalidation for prefix caching, and KV cache warmup for model KV. both impact latency and cost. need an infra spike before canary. estimate 2 sprints.
Marie (Eng-Architecture): also flag: network egress economics — routing to a different region to avoid local queuing can save latency but will hurt unit economics for some customers. add this to decision tradeoffs doc.
Evan (Eng-ML): ML note: model variants aren't always drop-in compatible. need compatibility matrix per model family in model catalog; fallback must consult it.
Lisa (Solutions): ask: can we expose a "routing preview" tool in console so customers can see how a tenant would be routed given their attributes? this reduces support load.
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): feasible as a server-side read-only API + console view. low risk. add to follow-up work.
Raj (PM): ownership proposals: 
- DSL & precedence: Marie
- SLO instrumentation & dashboards: Sanjay
- Model compatibility matrix: Evan
- Customer docs & preview tool: Lisa
- Rollout ops/playbook: Raj + infra oncall
Marie (Eng-Architecture): quick decision point: isolation tiers — full tenant isolation (dedicated slices) is heavy. propose 3 isolation modes: 
1) logical isolation (soft limits, shared infra)
2) affinity isolation (sticky routing, dedicated pools when needed)
3) dedicated tenant pools (Reserved capacity)
We should support all but default to logical.
Lisa (Solutions): customers with compliance needs will go straight to "dedicated tenant pools". need pricing and SLA docs ready.
Evan (Eng-ML): for affinity isolation, we must ensure model warm caches and placement topologies are pre-seeded or we see long cold start tails. implementation detail to include in playbook.
infra-bot: deploy-ci: build #2021 succeeded for routing-dsl v0 (sha: abc123) :white_check_mark:
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): nice. next steps: infra spike for KV invalidation (2 sprints), implement DSL parser + simple evaluator (1 sprint), metrics plumbing (1 sprint). estimate 4 sprints total to pilot.
Raj (PM): timeline check — with current velocity that aligns with Q4 pilot. ok if we aim for pilot by end of Oct.
Marie (Eng-Architecture): risks to catalog: model compatibility lag, and edge cases for mixed-residency requests. mitigation: blocklist for automatic cross-region fallback when request has residency constraints.
Lisa (Solutions): can we include a checkbox in tenancy onboarding for "allow cross-region fallback"? sellers can use that to negotiate.
Evan (Eng-ML): yes. plus add an explicit error path if cross-region blocked so apps can surface a user-friendly message instead of silent fallback.
Raj (PM): action items captured: Marie to PR DSL spec, Sanjay to schedule infra spike, Evan to start model compatibility matrix, Lisa to draft customer docs + onboarding checkbox, Raj to write rollout playbook. I'll follow up with a short decisions doc by EOD Friday.
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): tagging owners in project board.
Marie (Eng-Architecture): FYI I've added a short RFC draft to the arch folder with examples. will link here once pushed.
Lisa (Solutions): thanks team. can we reconvene next Tue for decision review?
Raj (PM): yep — Tue 10am PT. calendar invite on the way. :calendar:
